author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Companies will apparently do anything to show employee appreciation except give employees more money, more time off or more control over their lives.

After 44 years at Walmart? Flowers.
International Housekeeping Week? A workplace slumber party with beanbags and Netflix.
Employee Appreciation Day? Donuts.
Annual employee morale event? A trail mix buffet.

Customer Service Appreciation Week? Raffle tickets, Costco snacks and dress-up days.
And apparently taking a picture with a trash panda is employee appreciation now too.
In this video, we're looking at corporate employee appreciation, workplace culture, employee morale, HR, LinkedIn, raises, bonuses, employee recognition and some of the increasingly ridiculous ways companies try to convince workers they’re valued without providing anything particularly valuable.

There’s nothing wrong with giving employees food, having a barbecue or doing something fun at work.

title: COMPANIES WILL GIVE YOU ANYTHING EXCEPT A RAISE
